newSummonPrompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: Summonlab one-star full-body summon-art candidate for mass review. Input image: Image 1 is only the accepted rendering-style and realism-ceiling reference. Do not copy its person, braid, clothes, pose, palette, or progression. Primary request: Create exactly one completely new adult human hero matching the subject brief below. Style/medium: cinematic semi-realistic painted fantasy character drawing with clearly visible hand-painted brush planes, simplified but believable facial planes, intentional line-and-shape design, warm cohesive color, crisp costume construction, and the unmistakable finish of premium illustrated game key art. It must read as a drawing immediately. Do not render photographic skin, pore detail, lens effects, live-action lighting, or a hyperreal portrait. Do not use anime cel shading, plastic 3D, or a generic fantasy uniform. Composition: one weaponless adult, full body, calm neutral expression, three-quarter standing pose, both hands and both feet visible, centered with generous safe margin, warm pale parchment studio wash and soft grounding shadow. Rank: 1-star ordinary mortal—practical maintained clothing, no magic or elite regalia, but a memorable silhouette with future potential. Identity design: honor the specified body type rather than defaulting to a slim athletic figure. Make hairstyle, clothing construction, accessories, and tattoos part of the identity. Constraints: no star, number, label, text, card frame, UI, logo, watermark, weapon, shield, active magic, aura, glow, levitation, affinity effect, crown, full armor suit, extra person, sexualization, cropped limbs, smile, grin, exaggerated expression, or published-character resemblance.
